decision: MEMORY_SCOPE_RESOLVED_WITH_BOTH_SUFFICIENCY_CLAUSES_UNFIRED_ON_COST: the frozen outcome label SCRATCHPAD_CORRECT_BUT_COSTLY stands exactly as measured (result.json decision.frozen_outcome_label, audit.json recomputed_metrics.frozen_outcome_label = SCRATCHPAD_CORRECT_BUT_COSTLY, outcome_enum MIXED), and because audit.json is status=PASS with producer_claim_supported=true and required_fixes=[], this is a valid bounded transaction, not a repair. The measured separation is: (1) WITHIN_EPISODE_SCRATCHPAD - an arm that induces no parameters, compiles nothing across episodes and retains nothing between episodes, its entire memory being the local dict scratchpad_values created inside run_episode (research/frontier/arms/scratchpad.py:259) - reaches 1.0000 span-level action correctness at EVERY novelty rate, closes 100 percent of the residual headroom (headroom_closed_fraction 1.0000 at 0.00/0.25/0.50/0.75/1.00), closes 600/600 class-(iii) span occurrences by its own propagated value with 0 oracle fallbacks anywhere, and records 0 false compiled replays, at 48.00 abstract units/episode. Clause 2 leg (a) holds (1.0000 >= 0.9833), leg (b) fails (48.00 > 38.6). (2) CROSS_EPISODE_COMPILED_BINDING reaches the same 1.0000 but 0/600 class-(iii) closures come from its own binding-keyed cache - all 600 are DEOPT_TO_MODEL - because its preregistered key contains the handle VALUE and the handle is a pure function of the episode counter, so a class-(iii) cache hit is impossible by construction; its correctness is inherited from the perfect-policy oracle and the arm is untested as a mechanism. Clause 3 leg (a) holds only on that oracle-mediated basis and leg (b) fails at 48.204. (3) Clause 1 did not fire (best per-rate sigma_2 CI95 upper 0.1879 versus the 0.01 threshold), so the residual is real and large and was replicated field for field from the parent: sigma_1 0.6772, sigma_2 0.2228 [0.2125, 0.2335], sigma_3 0.1000 [0.0927, 0.1078], headroom sigma_2+sigma_3 0.3228 [0.3111, 0.3348] pooled, declining monotonically 0.3767 -> 0.2658 across the grid, over 4063/1337/600 of 6000 classified span occurrences. BOUNDED ARCHITECTURAL CONSEQUENCE: persistent cross-episode state is NOT necessary for span-level action correctness on this plan family, on this substrate, under this ledger - zero cross-epoch persistence attained 1.0000 - and its only surviving candidate role is AMORTIZATION, which remains unidentified because the one arm measured to amortize (the deopt ratchet, 40.712 pooled, rising 34.08 -> 47.06 with novelty) is unsound on exactly the spans that need a binding, and the one mechanism that was meant to fix it produced zero own-mechanism closures. The minimum persistent state is therefore bounded on one side (none is required for correctness) and still unidentified on the other (whether any sound persistent state amortizes at or below the declared bar). C-RESIDUAL-NOVELTY REMAINS EXPERIMENTAL: no downgrade, no VALIDATED, no REJECTED, no promotion, no SHIPPED.

next_question: Change the level of description a fourth time, from MEMORY SCOPE to IDENTIFIER AVAILABILITY AND STABILITY, because this run falsified the key rather than the cache. Established here: an arm with zero cross-episode persistence closed 600/600 class-(iii) spans by its own propagated value and 100 percent of the residual headroom at 1.0000 span-level action correctness (artifacts/scratchpad_closure.json), the incumbent state-keyed cache silently replayed 80 wrong actions (artifacts/reference_false_compile.json), and the preregistered cross-episode arm whose key contained the episode-scoped handle VALUE served 0/600 class-(iii) spans from its own cache and 1.0000 of its correctness from the perfect-policy oracle (artifacts/binding_compilation_closure.json). So: is a sound cross-episode replay cache possible at all, and what is the minimum agent-visible persistent state that makes replay sound? Preregister, on the same verified stdlib HTTP substrate with no new infrastructure, no browser, no docker, no model key and no network: (i) a POSITIVE arm whose cross-episode cache key binds a STABLE, episode-invariant, agent-visible identifier of the gating object - readable in a response body, equal across episodes, and sufficient together with observable state to determine the declared action - and which re-validates that identifier before replaying a compiled action; (ii) a NULL arm on a substrate variant in which the only readable identifier is episode-scoped, which must produce 0 own-mechanism class-(iii) closures and 100 percent oracle-mediated closure, thereby bounding the mechanism from the opposite side and separating a substrate limitation from a mechanism limitation; and (iii) the unchanged within-episode per-episode re-derivation arm as the sound-but-unamortized reference at 48.00 units/episode. Primary endpoint remains span-level action correctness against the shared declared plan action, and own-mechanism closure must be attributed per span and MUST NEVER be counted when it comes from a model-oracle deopt, because the single most consequential number in this packet (CROSS_EPISODE_COMPILED_BINDING at 1.0000) was produced entirely by oracle fallback and would have been misread as a mechanism result. Falsifier: if the stable-identifier cache serves class-(iii) spans from its own cache at span-level correctness >= 0.9833 and amortized cost <= its declared bar, then a sound cross-episode replay cache exists, the minimum persistent state is (observable state + stable identifier), and SPIDER's persistent cross-episode state is retained but RE-SPECIFIED rather than vindicated or dropped; if the stable-identifier cache also serves 0 class-(iii) spans from its own cache while per-episode re-derivation still reaches 1.0000, then NO cross-episode action-replay cache is sound on this substrate class and persistent cross-episode inheritance must be justified by amortization of something other than replayed actions - a justification the program has never measured. Before freeze, the successor must declare in its OWN spec.json and prereg.md, not inherit: (1) ONE cost basis that explicitly states whether a non-deopting arm's per-span policy decision is charged as a model unit, because that single undeclared choice decides this thread's headline - prereg.md 6.1 charges 1 model unit per span (scratchpad 48.00, clause 2 unfired), prereg.md 11 defines model as 1 unit per oracle call and the scratchpad makes zero oracle calls (24.00, clause 2 FIRED, persistent cross-episode inheritance declared unnecessary), and the parenthetical gloss gives 45.6 (unfired); (2) ONE class-(ii) rule AND ONE observable state key, since this run shows the state key and not the intent rule is what moves sigma_2 (goal-aware and literal are numerically identical at 0.2228 on identical data; the strictest prefix reading gives 0.0800; a world-store nonce gives exactly 0); and (3) the provenance of the economic bar, since 38.6 is the incumbent ratchet's amortized cost at novelty 0.50 on the no-plant generator while its pooled cost here with the plant is 40.712 and its per-rate values span 34.08 to 47.06, so no single constant is the incumbent's cost. The Director therefore makes an explicit conservative documentary adjudication and does not create a measurement: the frozen arm-level cost model at prereg.md 6.1 line 118 is the decision basis, the 24.0 figure is recorded as an ambiguity with its consequence quantified rather than adopted, and the asymmetry is deliberate - the same discipline the parent Director applied when it declined to fire a premise-falsifying clause on the 24.0 model-calls-only basis, now applied in the opposite direction. This ambiguity is a program-level prerequisite for any successor and is carried in handoff.dependencies, not resolved here. Lane is frontier, no product code was touched, no Product gate exists, and the two verdicts that would have licensed an architecture change did not fire; continue=false because the next step is a fourth change of level of description that needs a new Global Research Director mandate and a new preregistration, and because two of its prerequisites are program-level definitional decisions (the cost basis for non-deopting arms, and the state key that defines 'epistemically blocked') that no lane Director may settle unilaterally.
